module: Minimal export of the player's vehicle: writes to a JSON file (.nbexport.json) the list of nodes (position and optional name) and beams (node ids) of the active vehicle, as a point/edge graph. Useful to visualize or analyze a vehicle's physical structure in an external tool. File names are numbered automatically (export_<N>.nbexport.json) in the vehicle folder.
notes: Positions come from veh:getNodePosition(id) (coordinates relative to the vehicle's reference node) and are converted to {x, z, -y} before writing (code comment: "Z-up").
Beams are read from vdata.vdata.beams (fields id1, id2, cid); the id is -1 if cid is missing.
The file also contains vehicle = {id, jbeam, name}; exportFile returns false if there is no player vehicle or no data available.

exportFile.desc: Builds the graph of the active vehicle and writes it as JSON. Without a file name, uses suggestFilename(). Creates the destination folder if needed and logs the result.

filename.desc: Output file path (default: export_<N>.nbexport.json in the vehicle folder)

returns.desc: true if the write succeeded, false otherwise

suggestFilename.desc: Suggests the next free name export_<N>.nbexport.json in the active vehicle's folder (looks up existing files to increment N); creates the folder if needed.

returns.desc: Suggested path, or nil (error logged) if no vehicle folder is available
